experiment.title: SCE 2.5 Preventive Probe - IMDS Hop-Limit Enforcement + IAM Deny Block Credential Theft Chain (Attack Nodes 1.2 + 2.2)
experiment.description: Validates two chained preventive controls that together block the full IMDS credential-theft attack chain. Attack Node 1.2 (T1578): the restricted attacker IAM role receives AccessDenied for ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions on a production-tagged EC2 instance (P2: explicit IAM Deny scoped to Environment=production). Attack Node 2.2 (T1552.005): a probe EC2 instance simulating a co-located attacker process attempts unauthenticated IMDS credential retrieval via curl against 169.254.169.254; IMDSv2 enforcement (http_tokens=required, hop_limit=1) returns HTTP 401 blocking the unauthenticated request (P1). Hypothesis H1 asserts AccessDenied for the IMDS weakening attempt. H2 asserts the target instance IMDS state remains unchanged (http_tokens=required, hop_limit=1). H3 asserts the probe instance IMDS credential endpoint does not return HTTP 200 for IMDSv1 unauthenticated requests. Maps to ADT Nodes 1.1 (IAM Least-Privilege) and 2.1 (IMDSv2 Hop-Limit Enforcement), Attack Nodes 1.2 (T1578) and 2.2 (T1552.005).

steady-state-hypothesis.title: Target EC2 instance has IMDSv2 enforced (http_tokens=required, hop_limit=1), attacker role carries explicit Deny on ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions for Environment=production, and probe instance is SSM-reachable

probes.name: Verify IAM Deny blocked Attack 1.2 IMDS weakening (H1), target IMDS state unchanged (H2), and Attack 2.2 IMDS credential retrieval blocked by IMDSv2 enforcement (H3)

method.name: Provision CloudFormation stack with production-tagged target EC2 instance (IMDSv2 enforced), probe EC2 instance (simulates co-located attacker), attacker IAM role with Deny on ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions for Environment=production, and SSM-enabled instance profile
